Interface MutablePropertyMapView

public interface MutablePropertyMapView
An interface to a property-map-like object that can be modified.

TODO: This should have two superinterfaces, one shared with PropertyMap and another shared with PropertyMap.Builder.

  • Method Details

    • keySet

      Set<String> keySet()
      Return a set view of all of the keys in this view.

      The returned view is updated when this MutablePropertyMapView changes. Removing keys from the returned set view will remove those keys from the MutablePropertyMapView. Adding keys is not supported.

      Returns:
      set view of property keys

    • containsKey

      boolean containsKey(String key)
      Return whether a given key is present in this view.
      Parameters:
      key - a property key
      Returns:
      true if key is present

    • containsAll

      boolean containsAll(Collection<?> keys)
      Return whether all of the given keys are present in this view.
      Parameters:
      keys - a collection of property keys
      Returns:
      true if all of keys are present

    • isEmpty

      boolean isEmpty()
      Return whether this view is empty.
      Returns:
      true if size() == 0; false otherwise

    • size

      int size()
      Return the number of keys in this view.
      Returns:
      The number of keys in this view.

    • getValueTypeForKey

      Class<?> getValueTypeForKey(String key)
      Return a class indicating the type of the value for the given key.

      Intended for use by special library/framework code. See the analogous PropertyMap.getValueTypeForKey(String) for details.

      Parameters:
      key - a property key
      Returns:
      the class representing the type of the value stored for key
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if key is not found

    • toPropertyMap

      PropertyMap toPropertyMap()
      Return a property map copy of this view.
      Returns:
      the property map copy
